# Privacy policy

Effective 26 September 2026

## Who uses this app

Fleet Social is an owner-only publishing workspace for Fleet projects. Cloudflare Access protects the app. The public pages explain the service; they do not open account or publishing access.

## Data we handle

Fleet Social stores the operator's sign-in email, session records, project-attributed drafts, media, schedules, connected account identifiers, and delivery receipts. It uses essential session cookies for authentication.

Fleet Social uses YouTube API Services. When the operator connects YouTube, the app requests `youtube.upload` and `youtube.readonly`. It reads the authorized channel's ID, name, and avatar to identify the destination. It stores OAuth access and refresh credentials encrypted in Cloudflare D1. Draft MP4 files are stored in Cloudflare R2 until removed with the draft or account.

## How we use and share it

The app uses channel data to show which account will receive a video, refresh access when needed, upload an owner-approved MP4 to YouTube, and check the resulting video ID and visibility for a delivery receipt. Only the operator can approve a destination and upload. The app sends the approved video, title, description, and visibility to YouTube for publication. Cloudflare hosts the app, database, and media storage. Fleet Social does not sell Google user data or use it for advertising or model training.

## Control and deletion

The operator can disconnect a YouTube account in Accounts. This removes stored credentials and pending posts for that connection; an identifier and receipts for videos already published may remain in Posts. Drafts and their media can be deleted in the app, and deleting the Fleet Social account removes its remaining local data and stored media. A video already uploaded to YouTube remains there until removed in YouTube Studio. Google access can also be revoked in [Google Account permissions](https://myaccount.google.com/permissions).

## Other services and contact

Google's handling of data is described in the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). For questions or a data request, contact the Fleet Social operator through the [operator's public contact page](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/).

# Terms of use

Effective 26 September 2026

## Owner-only use

Fleet Social is an internal tool for the Fleet owner. Access to its publishing features requires authorization through Cloudflare Access. The operator decides which accounts to connect and which posts to approve.

## YouTube

By using Fleet Social's YouTube features, you agree to be bound by the [YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms). You must have the rights to upload each video and must follow YouTube's policies. Fleet Social sends a video to the selected channel only after an explicit approval of the saved draft and destination. YouTube determines how uploaded content is processed and displayed.

## Data

The [Fleet Social privacy policy](/privacy) explains connected account data, storage, deletion, and Google access revocation. Disconnecting an account does not delete videos already published on YouTube.
